# Palette Animation Investigation in Room 7 (2026-01-26 20:09Z)

_**User (2026-01-26 21:02Z)**_

in room 7, when using object number 7 (the amulet) in the hotspot 353 (the statue), theres a palette animation happening that transforms the colors of the statue into something more reddish, through a fade effect in several colors. We have not identified a palette animation so far in room 7. I need you to see where this animation comes from and how it is applied.

Note this are 8-bit palettes vs 6-bit in the game.

I know room 28 does a similar effect to "turn the light on" where it changes the room palette in alfred.1 to a different one through a fade. In that case hte palette is in alfred.7 (this is documented in the project docs). So possibly this one is as well.


Please analyze the ghidra code and try to figure out how to apply this effect as well. 

Do not use heredoc python. Clean up all the temp scripts after yourself. Rename on ghidra as yo go.

    "original": "cd /Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools &amp;&amp; python3 -c \"\nimport struct\n\n# The room graphics table in JUEGO.EXE\n# Memory address 0x488f4 -&gt; file offset for data segment\n# Data segment base is 0x43200 in JUEGO.EXE\n# So file offset = 0x488f4 - 0x40000 + 0x43200 = 0x4BBF4\n\n# But let's verify by looking at known patterns\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\n# Palette table is at memory 0x48924 \n# file_offset = mem_addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200 \n# But actually the EXE has code section starting at 0 and data elsewhere\n# Let me find the offset 0x1610CE in the EXE which is room 28's palette\n\n# Search for the value 0x1610CE (little-endian) in the EXE\nsearch_val = struct.pack('&lt;I', 0x1610CE)\npos = exe_data.find(search_val)\nprint(f'Searching for 0x1610CE in JUEGO.EXE...')\nwhile pos != -1:\n    print(f'  Found at file offset 0x{pos:08X}')\n    pos = exe_data.find(search_val, pos+1)\n\n# Look for room 28 (0x1c) check in disassembly - we know it's at 0x15bca\nprint()\nprint('Code at 0x15bca (room 28 palette load check):')\nprint('  CMP byte ptr [0x0005178c], 0x1c  ; check if previous room == 28')\nprint('  The palette offset 0x1610CE is loaded from code, not a table')\n\"",
    "toolEdited": " cd /Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools &amp;&amp; python3 -c \"\nimport struct\n\n# The room graphics table in JUEGO.EXE\n# Memory address 0x488f4 -&gt; file offset for data segment\n# Data segment base is 0x43200 in JUEGO.EXE\n# So file offset = 0x488f4 - 0x40000 + 0x43200 = 0x4BBF4\n\n# But let's verify by looking at known patterns\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\n# Palette table is at memory 0x48924 \n# file_offset = mem_addr - 0x40000 + 0x43200 \n# But actually the EXE has code section starting at 0 and data elsewhere\n# Let me find the offset 0x1610CE in the EXE which is room 28's palette\n\n# Search for the value 0x1610CE (little-endian) in the EXE\nsearch_val = struct.pack('&lt;I', 0x1610CE)\npos = exe_data.find(search_val)\nprint(f'Searching for 0x1610CE in JUEGO.EXE...')\nwhile pos != -1:\n    print(f'  Found at file offset 0x{pos:08X}')\n    pos = exe_data.find(search_val, pos+1)\n\n# Look for room 28 (0x1c) check in disassembly - we know it's at 0x15bca\nprint()\nprint('Code at 0x15bca (room 28 palette load check):')\nprint('  CMP byte ptr [0x0005178c], 0x1c  ; check if previous room == 28')\nprint('  The palette offset 0x1610CE is loaded from code, not a table')\n\""

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Disassemble code at 0x227be to understand what reads DAT_000495c4\"\"\"\nfrom capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Virtual address 0x000227be corresponds to file offset\n# .object1 starts at virtual 0x10000 and file offset 0x14200\n# So 0x227be = 0x14200 + (0x227be - 0x10000) = 0x14200 + 0x127be = 0x269be\nfile_offset = 0x269be\ncode = data[file_offset-50:file_offset+150]\nstart_addr = 0x000227be - 50\n\nmd = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n\nprint(f'Disassembly around virtual 0x000227be (reads DAT_000495c4):')\nprint('=' * 70)\n\nfor i in md.disasm(code, start_addr):\n    marker = ''\n    if i.address == 0x227be:\n        marker = '  &lt;-- READS 0x495c4'\n    elif i.address == 0x22842:\n        marker = '  &lt;-- READS/WRITES 0x495c4'\n    elif i.address == 0x22817:\n        marker = '  &lt;-- JUMPS to 0x22842'\n        \n    # Annotate known addresses\n    annotation = ''\n    if '0x495c4' in i.op_str or '0x95c4' in i.op_str:\n        annotation = '  ; DAT_000495c4'\n    elif '0x495b8' in i.op_str or '0x95b8' in i.op_str:\n        annotation = '  ; DAT_000495b8 (array base)'\n    elif '0x4fac8' in i.op_str or '0xfac8' in i.op_str:\n        annotation = '  ; room_sprite_data_ptr'\n    elif '0x4fb94' in i.op_str or '0xfb94' in i.op_str:\n        annotation = '  ; current_room_number'\n    elif '0x51738' in i.op_str or '0x1738' in i.op_str:\n        annotation = '  ; ambient_sound_frame_counter'\n    elif '0x3c8' in i.op_str:\n        annotation = '  ; VGA palette index port'\n    elif '0x3c9' in i.op_str:\n        annotation = '  ; VGA palette data port'\n    \n    print(f'0x{i.address:08x}:  {i.mnemonic:&lt;8s} {i.op_str}{annotation}{marker}')\n",

}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Disassemble larger area to find function boundaries and understand 0x495c4 usage\"\"\"\nfrom capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Virtual address 0x0002279c looks like a function start (push 0xc, call)\n# Let's get more context - from 0x22700 to 0x228a0\n# Virtual 0x22700 = 0x14200 + (0x22700 - 0x10000) = 0x14200 + 0x12700 = 0x26900\nfile_offset_start = 0x14200 + (0x22700 - 0x10000)\nfile_offset_end = 0x14200 + (0x228f0 - 0x10000)\ncode = data[file_offset_start:file_offset_end]\nstart_addr = 0x00022700\n\nmd = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)\n\nprint('Extended disassembly from 0x22700 to 0x228f0:')\nprint('=' * 80)\n\n# Known addresses for annotation\nannotations = {\n    0x0495c4: 'DAT_000495c4 (palette anim state)',\n    0x0495b8: 'DAT_000495b8 (flags array)',\n    0x0495b9: 'DAT_000495b9',\n    0x0495c3: 'DAT_000495c3',\n    0x04fac8: 'room_sprite_data_ptr',\n    0x04fb94: 'current_room_number',\n    0x051738: 'ambient_sound_frame_counter',\n    0x04b9e0: 'text_ptr (likely)',\n    0x04bb68: 'PTR_DAT_0004bb68',\n}\n\n# Known function addresses\nfunctions = {\n    0x27c2c: 'sound_cleanup',\n    0x2a218: 'get_current_room_number',\n    0x25487: 'display_text_with_voice',\n    0x24157: 'process_inventory_action',\n    0x1b666: 'update_conversation_state',\n    0x1b1a2: 'play_get_naked_easter_egg',\n}\n\n# Target addresses for highlighting\nhighlights = {\n    0x227be: 'READS 0x495c4',\n    0x22842: 'DEC 0x495c4',\n    0x22817: 'JUMPS to 0x22842',\n    0x2279c: 'POSSIBLE FUNCTION START',\n    0x227b2: 'ANOTHER POSSIBLE ENTRY',\n}\n\nfor i in md.disasm(code, start_addr):\n    marker = ''\n    if i.address in highlights:\n        marker = f'  &lt;-- {highlights[i.address]}'\n        \n    # Check for annotations in operand\n    annotation = ''\n    op = i.op_str\n    \n    # Check for address patterns (32-bit addresses get truncated in disasm)\n    for addr, name in annotations.items():\n        # Check various formats the address might appear\n        short = hex(addr &amp; 0xFFFF)[2:]  # e.g. 95c4\n        full = hex(addr)[2:]  # e.g. 495c4\n        if short in op or full in op:\n            annotation = f'  ; {name}'\n            break\n    \n    # Check for function calls\n    if i.mnemonic == 'call':\n        try:\n            # Extract call target\n            target_str = op.replace('0x', '')\n            target = int(target_str, 16)\n            if target in functions:\n                annotation = f'  ; {functions[target]}'\n        except:\n            pass\n    \n    # VGA ports\n    if '0x3c8' in op:\n        annotation = '  ; VGA palette index port'\n    elif '0x3c9' in op:\n        annotation = '  ; VGA palette data port'\n    \n    print(f'0x{i.address:08x}:  {i.mnemonic:&lt;8s} {i.op_str:&lt;35s}{annotation}{marker}')\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze INT9 keyboard interrupt handler in JUEGO.EXE\nThis handler appears to include palette animation code\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\nimport sys\n\naddresses = [\n    (0x1515c, 'INT9 handler start'),\n    (0x1518e, 'outport_byte call 1'),\n    (0x1519c, 'outport_byte call 2'),\n    (0x151a8, 'outport_byte call 3'),\n    (0x151d9, 'outport_byte call 4'),\n    (0x151e0, 'approximate end'),\n]\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\nprint(f'JUEGO.EXE size: {len(exe_data)} bytes')\nprint(f'Magic: {exe_data[0:2]}')\n\nsegment_base = 0x10000\n\nprint()\nprint('Analyzing addresses:')\nfor mem_addr, desc in addresses:\n    file_offset = mem_addr - segment_base\n    if 0 &lt;= file_offset &lt; len(exe_data):\n        bytes_at = exe_data[file_offset:file_offset+16]\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in bytes_at)\n        print(f'{mem_addr:08X} ({desc}): file offset {file_offset:05X} =&gt; {hex_str}')\n    else:\n        print(f'{mem_addr:08X} ({desc}): OUT OF RANGE')\n\n# Full dump of INT9 handler area\nprint()\nprint('Full hex dump of INT9 handler (0x1515c to 0x151f0):')\nfor offset in range(0x515c, 0x51f0, 16):\n    bytes_at = exe_data[offset:offset+16]\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in bytes_at)\n    ascii_str = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else '.' for b in bytes_at)\n    print(f'{offset+0x10000:08X}: {hex_str}  {ascii_str}')\n\n# Look for palette port references (0x3C8 = 968, 0x3C9 = 969)\nprint()\nprint('Looking for VGA palette port references in handler area:')\nhandler_bytes = exe_data[0x515c:0x51f0]\nfor i in range(len(handler_bytes) - 1):\n    val = struct.unpack('&lt;H', handler_bytes[i:i+2])[0]\n    if val == 0x3C8:\n        print(f'  Found 0x3C8 (palette index port) at offset +{i:02X} (address 0x{0x1515c+i:05X})')\n    if val == 0x3C9:\n        print(f'  Found 0x3C9 (palette data port) at offset +{i:02X} (address 0x{0x1515c+i:05X})')\n\n# Look for countdown timer address (0x495c4 = 300484)\nprint()\nprint('Looking for countdown timer address (0x495c4) references:')\nsearch_val = struct.pack('&lt;I', 0x495c4)\nfor i in range(len(exe_data) - 4):\n    if exe_data[i:i+4] == search_val:\n        mem_addr = i + segment_base\n        print(f'  Found at file offset 0x{i:05X} (memory 0x{mem_addr:08X})')\n\n# Also look for DAT_000516b4 (keyboard buffer) which we know is referenced\nprint()\nprint('Looking for keyboard buffer address (0x516b4) references in handler area:')\nhandler_bytes = exe_data[0x515c:0x51f0]\nsearch_val = struct.pack('&lt;I', 0x516b4)\nfor i in range(len(handler_bytes) - 4):\n    if handler_bytes[i:i+4] == search_val:\n        print(f'  Found at offset +{i:02X} (address 0x{0x1515c+i:05X})')\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSimple INT9 handler hex dump analysis\n\"\"\"\n\n# Read JUEGO.EXE\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    exe_data = f.read()\n\nprint(f'JUEGO.EXE size: {len(exe_data)} bytes')\n\n# Code segment base is 0x10000\nsegment_base = 0x10000\n\n# INT9 handler at 0x1515c\nhandler_start = 0x1515c - segment_base  # = 0x515c\nhandler_end = 0x51f0\n\nprint(f'\\nINT9 handler (0x1515c to 0x151f0):')\nprint(f'File offset: 0x{handler_start:05X} to 0x{handler_end:05X}')\nprint()\n\n# Dump hex\nfor offset in range(handler_start, handler_end, 16):\n    bytes_at = exe_data[offset:offset+16]\n    hex_str = ' '.join(f'{bytes_at[i]:02x}' if i &lt; len(bytes_at) else '  ' for i in range(16))\n    ascii_str = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else '.' for b in bytes_at)\n    print(f'{offset+segment_base:08X}: {hex_str}  {ascii_str}')\n\n# Look for VGA palette ports\nprint('\\n\\nSearching for VGA palette ports (0x3C8, 0x3C9):')\nimport struct\nhandler_bytes = exe_data[handler_start:handler_end]\nfor i in range(len(handler_bytes) - 1):\n    val = handler_bytes[i] | (handler_bytes[i+1] &lt;&lt; 8)\n    if val == 0x3C8:\n        print(f'  Found 0x3C8 at handler+0x{i:02X} (addr 0x{0x1515c+i:08X})')\n    if val == 0x3C9:\n        print(f'  Found 0x3C9 at handler+0x{i:02X} (addr 0x{0x1515c+i:08X})')\n\n# Look for calls to outport_byte (0x2b11b)\nprint('\\nSearching for calls to outport_byte (0x2b11b):')\noutport_addr = 0x2b11b\n# A CALL instruction is E8 + relative offset\nfor i in range(len(handler_bytes) - 5):\n    if handler_bytes[i] == 0xE8:  # CALL opcode\n        rel_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;i', handler_bytes[i+1:i+5])[0]\n        target_addr = (0x1515c + i + 5 + rel_offset) &amp; 0xFFFFFFFF\n        if target_addr == outport_addr:\n            print(f'  CALL to outport_byte at handler+0x{i:02X} (addr 0x{0x1515c+i:08X})')\n\n# Look for data address references\nprint('\\nSearching for data address references (0x0004xxxx):')\nfor i in range(len(handler_bytes) - 4):\n    val = struct.unpack('&lt;I', handler_bytes[i:i+4])[0]\n    if 0x00040000 &lt;= val &lt;= 0x00060000:\n        print(f'  Data reference 0x{val:08X} at handler+0x{i:02X} (addr 0x{0x1515c+i:08X})')\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport struct\n\n# Read the dispatch table at 0x48118 - each entry is 8 bytes\n# Format: [item1:2][item2:2][function_ptr:4]\n# File offset = mem_addr - 0x10000\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(0x38118)  # 0x48118 - 0x10000\n    data = f.read(512)\n\nprint('Item combination dispatch table at 0x48118:')\nfor i in range(0, min(len(data), 512), 8):\n    item1 = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[i:i+2])[0]\n    item2 = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[i+2:i+4])[0]\n    func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[i+4:i+8])[0]\n    if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n        print(f'  Entry {i//8}: END')\n        break\n    # Look for handler 0x227b2\n    marker = \" &lt;--- 0x227b2!\" if func_ptr == 0x227b2 else \"\"\n    # Look for item 7 (amulet) or hotspot 353\n    if item1 == 7 or item2 == 7 or item1 == 353 or item2 == 353:\n        marker += \" &lt;-- AMULET or 353\"\n    print(f'  Entry {i//8}: item1={item1:3d} (0x{item1:02X}), item2={item2:3d} (0x{item2:02X}), handler=0x{func_ptr:05X}{marker}')\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

Entries where function_ptr == 0x227b2:')\n        found = [e for e in entries if e[3] == 0x227b2]\n        if found:\n            for e in found:\n                output.append('   Entry %d: item1=%d (0x%04X), item2=%d (0x%04X)' % \n                             (e[0], e[1], e[1], e[2], e[2]))\n        else:\n            output.append('   None found')\n        \n        # Entries with item1 or item2 == 7 (amulet)\n        output.append('')\n        output.append('2. Entries where item1 or item2 == 7 (amulet):')\n        found = [e for e in entries if e[1] == 7 or e[2] == 7]\n        if found:\n            for e in found:\n                output.append('   Entry %d: item1=%d (0x%04X), item2=%d (0x%04X), func_ptr=0x%05X' % \n                             (e[0], e[1], e[1], e[2], e[2], e[3]))\n        else:\n            output.append('   None found')\n        \n        # Entries with item1 or item2 == 353 (statue hotspot)\n        output.append('')\n        output.append('3.       writable = obj_flags &amp; 0x2\n                flags_str = []\n                if readable: flags_str.append(\"READ\")\n                if writable: flags_str.append(\"WRITE\")\n                if executable: flags_str.append(\"EXEC\")\n                print(f\"  Access: {', '.join(flags_str)}\")\n            \n            print()\n            \n            # Parse page table\n            page_table_abs = le_base + page_table_offset\n            print(f\"=== Page Table at 0x{page_table_abs:x} ===\")\n            \n            for i in range(min(num_pages, 20)):  # Show first 20 pages\n                page_offset = page_table_abs + i * 4\n                page_entry = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, page_offset)[0]\n                page_num = page_entry &gt;&gt; 8\n                page_type = page_entry &amp; 0xFF\n                print(f\"  Page {i+1}: entry=0x{page_entry:08x}, page_num={page_num}, type={page_type}\")\n            \n            if num_pages &gt; 20:\n                print(f\"  ... ({num_pages - 20} more pages)\")\n            \n            print()\n            print(f\"=== Calculating file offsets ===\")\n            print()\n            \n            # Memory address to analyze\n            mem_addr = 0x4811c\n            print(f\"Target memory address: 0x{mem_addr:x}\")\n            \n            # Object 2 starts at 0x40000\n            obj2_base = 0x40000\n            offset_in_obj2 = mem_addr - obj2_base\n            print(f\"Object 2 base: 0x{obj2_base:x}\")\n            print(f\"Offset into Object 2: 0x{offset_in_obj2:x} ({offset_in_obj2})\")\n            \n            # Calculate which page this falls into (pages are 4096 bytes typically)\n            page_in_obj2 = offset_in_obj2 // page_size\n            offset_in_page = offset_in_obj2 % page_size\n            print(f\"Page within Object 2: {page_in_obj2}\")\n            print(f\"Offset within page: 0x{offset_in_page:x}\")\n            \n            print()\n            \n            # Now let's try different formulas based on found matches\n            for match in matches:\n                # Work backwards from file offset to memory address\n                # Try to find the relationship\n                print(f\"Match at file offset 0x{match:x}:\")\n                \n                # Calculate offset from data_pages_offset\n                offset_from_data = match - data_pages_offset\n                print(f\"  Offset from data_pages_offset (0x{data_pages_offset:x}): 0x{offset_from_data:x}\")\n                \n                # If this is object 2, what would the base file offset be?\n                implied_obj2_file_base = match - offset_in_obj2\n                print(f\"  If in object 2, implied file base for obj2: 0x{implied_obj2_file_base:x}\")\n                \n                # Check formula: file_offset = data_pages_offset + (obj1_pages * page_size) + offset_in_obj2\n                # We need to find how many pages object 1 has\n                \nprint()\nprint(\"=== Direct verification ===\")\n\n# Let's also dump bytes around each match for context\nfor match in matches:\n    print(f\"\\nBytes around file offset 0x{match:x}:\")\n    start = max(0, match - 8)\n    end = min(len(data), match + 12)\n    hex_dump = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in data[start:end])\n    print(f\"  {hex_dump}\")\n    print(f\"  Position of target within dump: {match - start}\")\n",

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/simple_search.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/simple_search.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport struct\n\n# Read the EXE file\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# Search for B2 27 02 00\npattern = bytes([0xB2, 0x27, 0x02, 0x00])\nresults = []\noffset = 0\nwhile True:\n    pos = data.find(pattern, offset)\n    if pos == -1:\n        break\n    results.append(pos)\n    offset = pos + 1\n\n# Write results\nwith open('file_offset_analysis.txt', 'w') as out:\n    out.write(f\"File size: {len(data)} bytes (0x{len(data):x})\\n\")\n    out.write(f\"Pattern: B2 27 02 00 (0x227b2 little-endian)\\n\\n\")\n    out.write(f\"Matches found: {len(results)}\\n\")\n    for pos in results:\n        out.write(f\"  File offset: 0x{pos:x} ({pos})\\n\")\n    \n    # MZ/LE header analysis\n    out.write(\"\\n=== EXE Header Analysis ===\\n\")\n    if data[:2] == b'MZ':\n        out.write(\"MZ (DOS) header found\\n\")\n        e_lfanew = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, 0x3C)[0]\n        out.write(f\"LE header offset: 0x{e_lfanew:x}\\n\")\n        \n        if data[e_lfanew:e_lfanew+2] == b'LE':\n            out.write(\"LE (Linear Executable) format confirmed\\n\\n\")\n            \n            le_base = e_lfanew\n            \n            # Key LE header fields\n            obj_table_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, le_base + 0x40)[0]\n            num_objects = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, le_base + 0x44)[0]\n            page_table_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, le_base + 0x48)[0]\n            data_pages_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, le_base + 0x80)[0]\n            page_size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, le_base + 0x28)[0]\n            num_pages = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, le_base + 0x14)[0]\n            \n            out.write(f\"Object table offset: 0x{obj_table_offset:x} (relative to LE header at 0x{le_base + obj_table_offset:x})\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"Number of objects: {num_objects}\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"Page table offset: 0x{page_table_offset:x} (absolute: 0x{le_base + page_table_offset:x})\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"Data pages offset: 0x{data_pages_offset:x}\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"Page size: {page_size}\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"Number of pages: {num_pages}\\n\\n\")\n            \n            # Parse objects\n            obj_table_abs = le_base + obj_table_offset\n            out.write(f\"=== Object Table ===\\n\")\n            for i in range(num_objects):\n                obj_off = obj_table_abs + i * 24\n                vsize = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, obj_off)[0]\n                base_addr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, obj_off + 4)[0]\n                flags = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, obj_off + 8)[0]\n                page_idx = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, obj_off + 12)[0]\n                num_page_entries = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, obj_off + 16)[0]\n                \n                out.write(f\"\\nObject {i+1}:\\n\")\n                out.write(f\"  Virtual size: 0x{vsize:x}\\n\")\n                out.write(f\"  Base address: 0x{base_addr:x}\\n\")\n                out.write(f\"  Flags: 0x{flags:x}\\n\")\n                out.write(f\"  Page map index: {page_idx} (1-based)\\n\")\n                out.write(f\"  Num page entries: {num_page_entries}\\n\")\n                \n                # Calculate file offset for this object's data\n                first_page = page_idx - 1  # Convert to 0-based\n                file_start = data_pages_offset + first_page * page_size\n                out.write(f\"  File offset (start): 0x{file_start:x}\\n\")\n                \n            # Now calculate the formula\n            out.write(\"\\n=== Memory Address to File Offset Calculation ===\\n\")\n            out.write(\"\\nGhidra info:\\n\")\n            out.write(\"  .object1 (code): 0x10000 - 0x3e096\\n\")\n            out.write(\"  .object2 (data): 0x40000 - 0x597df\\n\\n\")\n            \n            target_mem = 0x4811c\n            obj2_mem_base = 0x40000\n            offset_in_obj2 = target_mem - obj2_mem_base\n            out.write(f\"Target memory address: 0x{target_mem:x}\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"Object 2 memory base: 0x{obj2_mem_base:x}\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"Offset within object 2: 0x{offset_in_obj2:x}\\n\\n\")\n            \n            # Get object 2 info\n            obj2_off = obj_table_abs + 1 * 24  # Object 2 is index 1\n            obj2_page_idx = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, obj2_off + 12)[0]\n            obj2_first_page = obj2_page_idx - 1\n            obj2_file_start = data_pages_offset + obj2_first_page * page_size\n            \n            out.write(f\"Object 2 first page index: {obj2_page_idx} (1-based)\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"Object 2 file start: 0x{obj2_file_start:x}\\n\")\n            \n            expected_file_offset = obj2_file_start + offset_in_obj2\n            out.write(f\"\\nExpected file offset for 0x{target_mem:x}: 0x{expected_file_offset:x}\\n\")\n            \n            # Verify\n            if expected_file_offset &lt; len(data):\n                val = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, expected_file_offset)[0]\n                out.write(f\"Value at that offset: 0x{val:x}\\n\")\n                out.write(f\"Expected value: 0x227b2\\n\")\n                out.write(f\"Match: {val == 0x227b2}\\n\")\n            \n            # Show the formula\n            out.write(\"\\n=== FORMULA ===\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"For .object2 (data segment):\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"  file_offset = 0x{obj2_file_start:x} + (memory_address - 0x{obj2_mem_base:x})\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"  file_offset = 0x{obj2_file_start:x} + (memory_address - 0x40000)\\n\\n\")\n            \n            # Also compute for object 1\n            obj1_off = obj_table_abs + 0 * 24  # Object 1 is index 0\n            obj1_page_idx = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, obj1_off + 12)[0]\n            obj1_first_page = obj1_page_idx - 1\n            obj1_file_start = data_pages_offset + obj1_first_page * page_size\n            obj1_mem_base = 0x10000\n            \n            out.write(f\"For .object1 (code segment):\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"  file_offset = 0x{obj1_file_start:x} + (memory_address - 0x{obj1_mem_base:x})\\n\")\n            out.write(f\"  file_offset = 0x{obj1_file_start:x} + (memory_address - 0x10000)\\n\")\n\nprint(\"Done - check file_offset_analysis.txt\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
```

</tool-use>

Values stored in the file are \n**unrelocated**. When the program loads, pointers to code (object 1) have \n0x10000 added to them.\n\n### Example at 0x4811c\n\n- **Ghidra shows**: 0x227b2 (relocated - after adding object 1 base)\n- **File contains**: 0x127b2 (unrelocated - raw file value)\n- **Difference**: 0x10000 (object 1 base address)\n\nThis means 0x227b2 is a pointer to code at offset 0x127b2 within object 1.\n\n## Quick Reference Table\n\n| Memory Address | Segment | File Offset Formula |\n|----------------|---------|---------------------|\n| 0x10000-0x3e096 | Object 1 (code) | mem - 0x10000 + 0x14200 |\n| 0x40000-0x597df | Object 2 (data) | mem - 0x40000 + 0x43200 |\n\n## Raw Analysis Output\n\nFile size: 338345 bytes (0x529a9)\nPattern 1: B2 27 02 00 (0x227b2 little-endian) - NOT FOUND (relocated value)\nPattern 2: B2 27 01 00 (0x127b2 little-endian) - FOUND at file offset 0x4b31c\n\n=== EXE Header Analysis ===\nMZ (DOS) header found\nLE header offset: 0x2a50\nLE (Linear Executable) format confirmed\n\nObject table offset: 0xc4 (relative to LE header at 0x2b14)\nNumber of objects: 2\nPage table offset: 0xf4 (absolute: 0x2b44)\nData pages offset: 0x14200\nPage size: 4096\nNumber of pages: 63\n\n=== Object Table ===\n\nObject 1:\n  Virtual size: 0x2e097\n  Base address: 0x10000\n  Flags: 0x2045\n  Page map index: 1 (1-based)\n  Num page entries: 47\n  File offset (start): 0x14200\n\nObject 2:\n  Virtual size: 0x197e0\n  Base address: 0x40000\n  Flags: 0x2043\n  Page map index: 48 (1-based)\n  Num page entries: 16\n  File offset (start): 0x43200\n\n=== Verification ===\nMemory 0x4811c -&gt;   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Find which item combination entry calls 0x227b2\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\n# Memory address 0x48118 = file offset 0x4B318\nFILE_OFFSET = 0x4B318\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(FILE_OFFSET)\n    for i in range(120):\n        data = f.read(8)\n        item1, item2, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', data)\n        if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n            print('End of table')\n            break\n        # The table stores addresses relative to segment base\n        # Ghidra reports addresses like 0x227b2 in the flat memory model\n        # The table uses raw segment addresses like 0x127b2\n        # Check both raw and adjusted\n        if func_ptr == 0x227b2 or func_ptr == 0x127b2:\n            print(f'FOUND! Entry {i}: item1={item1} (0x{item1:04x}), item2={item2} (0x{item2:04x}), func_ptr=0x{func_ptr:05x}')\n        # Also check if adjusted equals our target\n        loaded_addr = func_ptr + 0x10000\n        if loaded_addr == 0x227b2:\n            print(f'ADJUSTED FOUND! Entry {i}: item1={item1} (0x{item1:04x}), item2={item2} (0x{item2:04x}), raw_func=0x{func_ptr:05x}')\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze the function at entry 6 of item combination table (amulet + statue)\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    # Check entry 6\n    entry_file_offset = 0x4B318 + (6 * 8)\n    f.seek(entry_file_offset)\n    data = f.read(8)\n    item1, item2, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', data)\n    print(f'Entry 6 at file offset 0x{entry_file_offset:X}:')\n    print(f'  item1={item1} (0x{item1:04X})')\n    print(f'  item2={item2} (0x{item2:04X})')  \n    print(f'  func_ptr=0x{func_ptr:05X}')\n    \n    # Code segment: file = 0x14200 + (mem - 0x10000)\n    code_file_offset = 0x14200 + (func_ptr - 0x10000)\n    print(f'\\nFunction at memory 0x{func_ptr:05X}')\n    print(f'  Code file offset: 0x{code_file_offset:05X}')\n    \n    f.seek(code_file_offset)\n    code_bytes = f.read(64)\n    print(f'  First 64 bytes: {code_bytes.hex()}')\n    \n    # Dump context for disassembly\n    f.seek(code_file_offset - 16)\n    pre_bytes = f.read(96)\n    print(f'\\nContext (-16 to +80):')\n    for i in range(0, 96, 16):\n        addr = (func_ptr - 16 + i)\n        hex_str = pre_bytes[i:i+16].hex()\n        formatted = ' '.join(hex_str[j:j+2] for j in range(0, 32, 2))\n        print(f'  0x{addr:05X}: {formatted}')\n\n    # Also check what function is around this address by looking at nearby PUSH/RET patterns\n    print('\\n--- Looking for function boundaries ---')\n    f.seek(code_file_offset - 64)\n    surrounding = f.read(256)\n    \n    # Look for common function prologue patterns: 0x55 = PUSH EBP, 0x53 = PUSH EBX\n    for i in range(len(surrounding) - 4):\n        if surrounding[i:i+2] == b'\\x55\\x8b':  # PUSH EBP; MOV EBP, ...\n            mem_addr = func_ptr - 64 + i\n            print(f'  Potential function start at 0x{mem_addr:05X} (PUSH EBP; MOV)')\n        elif surrounding[i] == 0xC3 or surrounding[i:i+2] == b'\\xc2\\x00':  # RET or RET imm\n            mem_addr = func_ptr - 64 + i\n            print(f'  RET at 0x{mem_addr:05X}')\n",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Analyze the function at entry 6 of item combination table (amulet + statue) - Extended\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport sys\n\n# Redirect output to file\noutput_file = open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/entry6_analysis2.txt', 'w')\nsys.stdout = output_file\n\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    # Check entry 6\n    entry_file_offset = 0x4B318 + (6 * 8)\n    f.seek(entry_file_offset)\n    data = f.read(8)\n    item1, item2, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', data)\n    print(f'Entry 6 at file offset 0x{entry_file_offset:X}:')\n    print(f'  item1={item1} (0x{item1:04X})')\n    print(f'  item2={item2} (0x{item2:04X})')  \n    print(f'  func_ptr=0x{func_ptr:05X}')\n    \n    # Code segment: file = 0x14200 + (mem - 0x10000)\n    code_file_offset = 0x14200 + (func_ptr - 0x10000)\n    print(f'\\nFunction at memory 0x{func_ptr:05X}')\n    print(f'  Code file offset: 0x{code_file_offset:05X}')\n    \n    # Look back much further to find function start\n    print('\\n--- Extended context (-256 to +128) ---')\n    f.seek(code_file_offset - 256)\n    surrounding = f.read(384)\n    \n    for i in range(0, 384, 16):\n        addr = func_ptr - 256 + i\n        hex_str = surrounding[i:i+16].hex()\n        formatted = ' '.join(hex_str[j:j+2] for j in range(0, 32, 2))\n        marker = ' &lt;-- TARGET' if addr &lt;= func_ptr &lt; addr + 16 else ''\n        print(f'  0x{addr:05X}: {formatted}{marker}')\n    \n    # Look for function boundaries\n    print('\\n--- Function boundaries in extended range ---')\n    for i in range(len(surrounding) - 4):\n        mem_addr = func_ptr - 256 + i\n        # PUSH EBP (55) followed by MOV EBP, ESP (8B EC or 89 E5)\n        if surrounding[i] == 0x55 and i+1 &lt; len(surrounding):\n            if surrounding[i+1:i+3] == b'\\x8b\\xec' or surrounding[i+1:i+3] == b'\\x89\\xe5':\n                print(f'  Function start at 0x{mem_addr:05X} (PUSH EBP; MOV EBP, ESP)')\n        # Just PUSH (6A xx 68 xx) - common patterns\n        if surrounding[i] == 0x6a and i &gt;= 1:  # PUSH imm8\n            if surrounding[i-1] == 0xC3 or surrounding[i-1] == 0xCB:  # After RET\n                print(f'  Likely function start at 0x{mem_addr:05X} (PUSH after RET)')\n        # RET patterns\n        if surrounding[i] == 0xC3:\n            print(f'  RET at 0x{mem_addr:05X}')\n        elif surrounding[i:i+2] == b'\\xc2\\x04':  # RET 4\n            print(f'  RET 4 at 0x{mem_addr:05X}')\n        elif surrounding[i:i+2] == b'\\xc2\\x08':  # RET 8\n            print(f'  RET 8 at 0x{mem_addr:05X}')\n            \n    # Also check all nearby entries in the item table\n    print('\\n--- Nearby item table entries ---')\n    for entry_idx in range(4, 10):\n        f.seek(0x4B318 + entry_idx * 8)\n        data = f.read(8)\n        e_item1, e_item2, e_func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', data)\n        if e_item1 == 0xFFFF:\n            break\n        print(f'  Entry {entry_idx}: item1={e_item1}, item2={e_item2}, func_ptr=0x{e_func_ptr:05X}')\n        \noutput_file.close()\nprint('Analysis written to entry6_analysis2.txt', file=sys.__stdout__)\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

Common instruction patterns\n        if b == 0xC3:\n            result.append((addr, 'RET', 1))\n            break\n        elif b == 0x31:\n            result.append((addr, f'XOR ...', 2))\n            offset += 2\n        elif b == 0x66:\n            result.append((addr, f'DATA16 PREFIX', 1))\n            offset += 1\n        elif b == 0x83:\n            result.append((addr, f'CMP/ADD/SUB imm8', 3))\n            offset += 3\n        elif b == 0x8B:\n            result.append((addr, f'MOV reg,r/m', 2))\n            offset += 2\n        elif b == 0x89:\n            result.append((addr, f'MOV r/m,reg', 2))\n            offset += 2\n        elif b == 0xA0 or b == 0xA1:\n            result.append((addr, f'MOV AL/EAX,moffs', 5))\n            offset += 5\n        elif b == 0xE8:\n            # CALL rel32\n            if offset + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[offset+1:offset+5])[0]\n                target = addr + 5 + rel\n                result.append((addr, f'CALL 0x{target:05X}', 5))\n            offset += 5\n        elif b == 0x7C or b == 0x7D or b == 0x7F or b == 0x74 or b == 0x75:\n            # Short conditional jumps\n            rel = struct.unpack('b', bytes([data[offset+1]]))[0]\n            target = addr + 2 + rel\n            jmp_type = {0x7C: 'JL', 0x7D: 'JGE', 0x7F: 'JG', 0x74: 'JZ', 0x75: 'JNZ'}\n            result.append((addr, f'{jmp_type.get(b, \"Jcc\")} 0x{target:05X}', 2))\n            offset += 2\n        elif b == 0xEB:\n            # JMP short\n            rel = struct.unpack('b', bytes([data[offset+1]]))[0]\n            target = addr + 2 + rel\n            result.append((addr, f'JMP short 0x{target:05X}', 2))\n            offset += 2\n        elif b == 0xE9:\n            # JMP near\n            if offset + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                rel = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[offset+1:offset+5])[0]\n                target = addr + 5 + rel\n                result.append((addr, f'JMP 0x{target:05X}', 5))\n            offset += 5\n        elif b == 0x0F:\n            # Two-byte opcode\n            result.append((addr, f'0F {data[offset+1]:02X} ...', 6))\n            offset += 6\n        elif b in (0x50, 0x51, 0x52, 0x53, 0x54, 0x55, 0x56, 0x57):\n            regs = ['EAX','ECX','EDX','EBX','ESP','EBP','ESI','EDI']\n            result.append((addr, f'PUSH {regs[b-0x50]}', 1))\n            offset += 1\n        elif b in (0x58, 0x59, 0x5A, 0x5B, 0x5C, 0x5D, 0x5E, 0x5F):\n            regs = ['EAX','ECX','EDX','EBX','ESP','EBP','ESI','EDI']\n            result.append((addr, f'POP {regs[b-0x58]}', 1))\n            offset += 1\n        elif b == 0xB8:\n            # MOV EAX, imm32\n            if offset + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[offset+1:offset+5])[0]\n                result.append((addr, f'MOV EAX, 0x{imm:X}', 5))\n            offset += 5\n        elif b == 0xBA:\n            # MOV EDX, imm32\n            if offset + 5 &lt;= len(data):\n                imm = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[offset+1:offset+5])[0]\n                result.append((addr, f'MOV EDX, 0x{imm:X}', 5))\n            offset += 5\n        elif b == 0xC1:\n            # SHL/SHR/SAR r/m, imm8\n            result.append((addr, f'SHIFT ...', 3))\n            offset += 3\n        elif b == 0x01:\n            result.append((addr, f'ADD r/m,reg', 2))\n            offset += 2\n        elif b == 0x29:\n            result.append((addr, f'SUB r/m,reg', 2))\n            offset += 2\n        elif b == 0x81:\n            # ADD/OR/ADC/SBB/AND/SUB/XOR/CMP r/m32, imm32\n            result.append((addr, f'OP r/m32, imm32', 6))\n            offset += 6\n        elif b == 0xB1:\n            # MOV CL, imm8\n            result.append((addr, f'MOV CL, 0x{data[offset+1]:02X}', 2))\n            offset += 2\n        elif b == 0x84:\n            result.append((addr, f'TEST r8,r8', 2))\n            offset += 2\n        else:\n            result.append((addr, f'{b:02X}', 1))\n            offset += 1\n    return result\n\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    func_ptr = 0x12CC1\n    code_file_offset = 0x14200 + (func_ptr - 0x10000)\n    \n    print('='*70)\n    print('AMULET + STATUE HANDLER ANALYSIS')\n    print('Entry 6: item1=353 (statue), item2=7 (amulet)')\n    print(f'Function pointer: 0x{func_ptr:05X}')\n    print(f'File offset: 0x{code_file_offset:05X}')\n    print('='*70)\n    \n    # Look for references to palette-related values\n    print('\\n' + '='*70)\n    print('SEARCHING FOR PALETTE-RELATED PATTERNS')\n    print('='*70)\n    \n    # Pattern: 0x3C8 (VGA palette index port)\n    # Pattern: 0x3C9 (VGA palette data port)\n    # Pattern: value 13 (frame count)\n    \n    for i in range(len(func_bytes) - 4):\n        # Look for 0x3C8 or 0x3C9 (little endian)\n        word = struct.unpack('&lt;H', func_bytes[i:i+2])[0]\n        if word == 0x3C8:\n            print(f'  Found 0x3C8 at offset +0x{i:X} (addr 0x{func_ptr+i:05X})')\n        if word == 0x3C9:\n            print(f'  Found 0x3C9 at offset +0x{i:X} (addr 0x{func_ptr+i:05X})')\n        # Look for value 13 (0x0D)\n        if func_bytes[i] == 0x0D:\n            # Check if it's likely a constant\n            if i &gt; 0 and func_bytes[i-1] in (0xB1, 0xB9, 0x83):  # MOV CL, MOV ECX, CMP\n                print(f'  Found potential 13 value at offset +0x{i:X} (addr 0x{func_ptr+i:05X})')\n\noutput_file.close()\nprint('Analysis written to entry6_deep_analysis.txt', file=sys.__stdout__)\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Search for palette fade code patterns in JUEGO.EXE code segment\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport sys\n\noutput_file = open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/palette_fade_search.txt', 'w')\nsys.stdout = output_file\n\nprint('='*70)\nprint('SEARCHING FOR PALETTE FADE CODE IN JUEGO.EXE')\nprint('='*70)\n\n# Patterns to look for:\n# 1. out dx, al (0xEE) with dx = 0x3C8 or 0x3C9\n# 2. Loop counters around 13 (0x0D)\n# 3. References to room 7\n\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    # Code segment: file offset 0x14200 corresponds to memory 0x10000\n    CODE_OFFSET = 0x14200\n    CODE_SIZE = 0x2F000  # Approximate code segment size\n    \n    f.seek(CODE_OFFSET)\n    code = f.read(CODE_SIZE)\n    \n    print(f'\\nSearching code segment (file 0x{CODE_OFFSET:X} - 0x{CODE_OFFSET+CODE_SIZE:X})')\n    print(f'Memory range: 0x10000 - 0x{0x10000+CODE_SIZE:X}')\n    \n    # Search for OUT DX, AL (0xEE) preceded by MOV DX, 0x3C8\n    print('\\n--- Searching for OUT instructions to VGA palette ports ---')\n    out_locations = []\n    for i in range(len(code) - 10):\n        mem_addr = 0x10000 + i\n        \n        # Look for: BA C8 03 00 00  (MOV EDX, 0x3C8) followed later by EE (OUT DX, AL)\n        # Or: 66 BA C8 03 (MOV DX, 0x3C8)\n        # Or: E6 C8 (OUT 0xC8, AL) - unlikely for VGA\n        \n        # Pattern: MOV DX, 0x3C8 (66 BA C8 03) \n        if code[i:i+4] == bytes([0x66, 0xBA, 0xC8, 0x03]):\n            out_locations.append((mem_addr, 'MOV DX, 0x3C8'))\n        \n        # Pattern: MOV DX, 0x3C9 (66 BA C9 03)\n        if code[i:i+4] == bytes([0x66, 0xBA, 0xC9, 0x03]):\n            out_locations.append((mem_addr, 'MOV DX, 0x3C9'))\n        \n        # Pattern: PUSH 0x3C8 (68 C8 03 00 00)\n        if code[i:i+5] == bytes([0x68, 0xC8, 0x03, 0x00, 0x00]):\n            out_locations.append((mem_addr, 'PUSH 0x3C8'))\n        \n        # OUT DX, AL (0xEE)\n        if code[i] == 0xEE:\n            out_locations.append((mem_addr, 'OUT DX, AL'))\n    \n    for addr, desc in out_locations[:50]:  # First 50\n        file_off = CODE_OFFSET + (addr - 0x10000)\n        print(f'  0x{addr:05X} (file 0x{file_off:05X}): {desc}')\n    \n    if len(out_locations) &gt; 50:\n        print(f'  ... and {len(out_locations) - 50} more')\n    \n    # Search for loop with value 13 (0x0D)\n    print('\\n--- Searching for loops with count 13 ---')\n    thirteen_patterns = []\n    for i in range(len(code) - 4):\n        mem_addr = 0x10000 + i\n        \n        # CMP reg, 0x0D (83 F8 0D for CMP EAX, 0x0D, etc.)\n        if code[i] == 0x83 and i+2 &lt; len(code) and code[i+2] == 0x0D:\n            thirteen_patterns.append((mem_addr, f'CMP/ADD/SUB imm8=0x0D (opcode {code[i]:02X} {code[i+1]:02X} {code[i+2]:02X})'))\n        \n        # MOV CL, 0x0D (B1 0D)\n        if code[i:i+2] == bytes([0xB1, 0x0D]):\n            thirteen_patterns.append((mem_addr, 'MOV CL, 0x0D'))\n        \n        # MOV ECX, 0x0D (B9 0D 00 00 00)\n        if code[i:i+5] == bytes([0xB9, 0x0D, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00]):\n            thirteen_patterns.append((mem_addr, 'MOV ECX, 0x0D'))\n    \n    for addr, desc in thirteen_patterns[:30]:\n        file_off = CODE_OFFSET + (addr - 0x10000)\n        print(f'  0x{addr:05X} (file 0x{file_off:05X}): {desc}')\n    \n    # Search for room 7 comparison\n    print('\\n--- Searching for room 7 checks ---')\n    room7_patterns = []\n    for i in range(len(code) - 6):\n        mem_addr = 0x10000 + i\n        \n        # CMP DWORD PTR [addr], 7 or CMP BYTE PTR [addr], 7\n        # CMP EAX, 7 (83 F8 07)\n        if code[i:i+3] == bytes([0x83, 0xF8, 0x07]):\n            room7_patterns.append((mem_addr, 'CMP EAX, 7'))\n        \n        # CMP reg, 7 with other registers\n        if code[i] == 0x83 and i+2 &lt; len(code) and code[i+2] == 0x07:\n            room7_patterns.append((mem_addr, f'CMP/OP reg, 7 ({code[i]:02X} {code[i+1]:02X} 07)'))\n    \n    for addr, desc in room7_patterns[:20]:\n        file_off = CODE_OFFSET + (addr - 0x10000)\n        print(f'  0x{addr:05X} (file 0x{file_off:05X}): {desc}')\n    \n    # Look for outport_byte function calls\n    print('\\n--- Looking for outport_byte function references ---')\n    # From Ghidra, outport_byte is at a certain address - let's find it\n    # It takes port and value\n    \n    # Look for the actual item handler functions\n    print('\\n--- Checking item handler function pointers ---')\n    \n    # Read the item table directly\n    f.seek(0x4B318)  # File offset for item table\n    for i in range(20):\n        entry = f.read(8)\n        if len(entry) &lt; 8:\n            break\n        item1, item2, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', entry)\n        if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n            break\n        code_file = 0x14200 + (func_ptr - 0x10000)\n        \n        # Read first few bytes at that function\n        pos = f.tell()\n        f.seek(code_file)\n        func_bytes = f.read(16)\n        f.seek(pos)\n        \n        print(f'  Entry {i}: items=({item1}, {item2}), func=0x{func_ptr:05X}, bytes={func_bytes.hex()[:32]}')\n\noutput_file.close()\nprint('Analysis written to palette_fade_search.txt', file=sys.__stdout__)\n",

}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the code at item handler 0x12CC1 (amulet+statue handler)\nFile offset = 0x14200 + (0x12CC1 - 0x10000) = 0x16EC1\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef read_bytes_at_offset(f, offset, count):\n    f.seek(offset)\n    return f.read(count)\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    # Handler at 0x12CC1\n    file_offset = 0x14200 + (0x12CC1 - 0x10000)  # = 0x16EC1\n    \n    lines = []\n    lines.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    lines.append(\"STATUE+AMULET HANDLER ANALYSIS\")\n    lines.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    lines.append(f\"Memory address: 0x12CC1\")\n    lines.append(f\"File offset: 0x{file_offset:X}\")\n    lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Read 256 bytes starting at handler\n    data = read_bytes_at_offset(f, file_offset, 256)\n    \n    lines.append(\"Raw bytes at handler start (256 bytes):\")\n    for i in range(0, 256, 16):\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in data[i:i+16])\n        addr = 0x12CC1 + i\n        ascii_str = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else '.' for b in data[i:i+16])\n        lines.append(f\"0x{addr:05X}: {hex_str}  {ascii_str}\")\n    \n    lines.append(\"\")\n    lines.append(\"Looking for key patterns:\")\n    lines.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Search for OUT instruction (0xEE or 0xEF or 0xE6/E7)\n    for i, b in enumerate(data):\n        if b == 0xEE or b == 0xEF or b == 0xE6 or b == 0xE7:\n            addr = 0x12CC1 + i\n            context = data[max(0,i-2):min(len(data),i+6)]\n            lines.append(f\"  Potential OUT at 0x{addr:05X}: {' '.join(f'{x:02x}' for x in context)}\")\n    \n    # Search for values 13 (0x0D) - might be frame count\n    for i, b in enumerate(data):\n        if b == 0x0D:\n            addr = 0x12CC1 + i\n            context = data[max(0,i-2):min(len(data),i+4)]\n            lines.append(f\"  Value 0x0D at 0x{addr:05X}: {' '.join(f'{x:02x}' for x in context)}\")\n    \n    # Search for CALL instructions (0xE8)\n    for i, b in enumerate(data):\n        if b == 0xE8:\n            if i + 4 &lt; len(data):\n                rel_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[i+1:i+5])[0]\n                target = 0x12CC1 + i + 5 + rel_offset\n                addr = 0x12CC1 + i\n                lines.append(f\"  CALL at 0x{addr:05X} -&gt; 0x{target:05X}\")\n    \n    # Search for VGA palette port values (0x3C8, 0x3C9 - these would be in immediate values)\n    for i in range(len(data)-1):\n        word = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[i:i+2])[0]\n        if word == 0x03C8 or word == 0x03C9:\n            addr = 0x12CC1 + i\n            context = data[max(0,i-2):min(len(data),i+6)]\n            lines.append(f\"  VGA port 0x{word:04X} at 0x{addr:05X}: {' '.join(f'{x:02x}' for x in context)}\")\n    \n    # Now let's also look at the dispatch table entry to see the context\n    lines.append(\"\")\n    lines.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    lines.append(\"ITEM TABLE ENTRY 6 VERIFICATION\")\n    lines.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    # Item table at file offset 0x4B318 + (6 * 8) = 0x4B348\n    entry_offset = 0x4B318 + (6 * 8)\n    entry_data = read_bytes_at_offset(f, entry_offset, 8)\n    item1, item2, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', entry_data)\n    \n    lines.append(f\"Entry 6 at file 0x{entry_offset:X}:\")\n    lines.append(f\"  Raw: {' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in entry_data)}\")\n    lines.append(f\"  item1 = {item1} (0x{item1:X})\")\n    lines.append(f\"  item2 = {item2} (0x{item2:X})\")\n    lines.append(f\"  func_ptr = 0x{func_ptr:X}\")\n    \noutput_path = 'handler_bytes_analysis.txt'\nwith open(output_path, 'w') as out:\n    out.write('\\n'.join(lines))\n    \nprint(f\"Analysis written to {output_path}\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch JUEGO.EXE for palette fade patterns\nLooking for:\n1. OUT instructions to ports 0x3C8/0x3C9\n2. Loops with counter 13 (0x0D)\n3. Red color manipulation (high R, low G/B)\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef search_pattern(data, pattern):\n    results = []\n    for i in range(len(data) - len(pattern)):\n        match = True\n        for j, p in enumerate(pattern):\n            if p is not None and data[i+j] != p:\n                match = False\n                break\n        if match:\n            results.append(i)\n    return results\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nlines = []\nlines.append(\"=\" * 70)\nlines.append(\"SEARCHING FOR PALETTE FADE CODE\")\nlines.append(\"=\" * 70)\n\n# Code section starts at 0x14200, data at 0x43200\nCODE_START = 0x14200\nCODE_BASE = 0x10000\nDATA_START = 0x43200\nDATA_BASE = 0x40000\n\n# Search for OUT DX, AL (0xEE) pattern - used for VGA port writes\nlines.append(\"\\n1. Searching for OUT DX, AL (0xEE) in code section...\")\nfor i in range(CODE_START, min(CODE_START + 0x30000, len(data))):\n    if data[i] == 0xEE:\n        mem_addr = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        context = data[max(0,i-10):min(len(data),i+10)]\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n        lines.append(f\"  0x{mem_addr:05X}: ...{hex_str}...\")\n\n# Search for MOV DX, 0x3C8 pattern (BA C8 03 or 66 BA C8 03)\nlines.append(\"\\n2. Searching for MOV DX, 0x3C8 patterns...\")\nfor i in range(CODE_START, min(CODE_START + 0x30000, len(data)-3)):\n    # BA C8 03 (32-bit)\n    if data[i] == 0xBA and data[i+1] == 0xC8 and data[i+2] == 0x03:\n        mem_addr = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        context = data[i:min(len(data),i+20)]\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n        lines.append(f\"  0x{mem_addr:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n    # 66 BA C8 03 (16-bit operand prefix)\n    if data[i] == 0x66 and data[i+1] == 0xBA and data[i+2] == 0xC8 and data[i+3] == 0x03:\n        mem_addr = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        context = data[i:min(len(data),i+20)]\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n        lines.append(f\"  0x{mem_addr:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n\n# Search for PUSH 0x3C8 (68 C8 03 00 00) \nlines.append(\"\\n3. Searching for PUSH 0x3C8 (immediate)...\")\nfor i in range(CODE_START, min(CODE_START + 0x30000, len(data)-5)):\n    if data[i] == 0x68 and data[i+1] == 0xC8 and data[i+2] == 0x03 and data[i+3] == 0x00:\n        mem_addr = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        context = data[i:min(len(data),i+20)]\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n        lines.append(f\"  0x{mem_addr:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n\n# Look for the outport_byte function calls with 0x3C8 as parameter\n# The function is at 0x2B11B\n# Calls would be like: PUSH value; PUSH 0x3C8; CALL outport_byte\nlines.append(\"\\n4. Searching near calls to outport_byte (0x2B11B)...\")\n# Calculate file offset of outport_byte\noutport_file = 0x14200 + (0x2B11B - 0x10000)\n# Read nearby calls\nfor i in range(CODE_START, min(CODE_START + 0x30000, len(data)-5)):\n    if data[i] == 0xE8:  # CALL relative\n        rel_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[i+1:i+5])[0]\n        call_from = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        call_to = call_from + 5 + rel_offset\n        if call_to == 0x2B11B:\n            # Found a call to outport_byte, check context\n            context = data[max(0,i-15):min(len(data),i+10)]\n            hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n            lines.append(f\"  Call from 0x{call_from:05X}: ...{hex_str}...\")\n\n# Search in the area around handler addresses \nlines.append(\"\\n5. Searching within item handler address range (0x127B2 - 0x15471)...\")\nhandler_start = 0x14200 + (0x127B2 - 0x10000)\nhandler_end = 0x14200 + (0x15471 - 0x10000)\nfor i in range(handler_start, min(handler_end, len(data)-5)):\n    if data[i] == 0xE8:\n        rel_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;i', data[i+1:i+5])[0]\n        call_from = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        call_to = call_from + 5 + rel_offset\n        if call_to == 0x2B11B:\n            context = data[max(0,i-15):min(len(data),i+10)]\n            hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n            lines.append(f\"  Call from 0x{call_from:05X} to outport_byte: ...{hex_str}...\")\n\n# Look for loops with 13 iterations (CMP with 0x0D or MOV with 0x0D then loop)\nlines.append(\"\\n6. Searching for value 13 (0x0D) in code...\")\nfor i in range(CODE_START, min(CODE_START + 0x20000, len(data)-3)):\n    # CMP xxx, 0x0D\n    if data[i] in [0x83, 0x3C, 0x3D, 0x80] and data[i+2] == 0x0D:\n        mem_addr = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        context = data[max(0,i-2):min(len(data),i+10)]\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n        lines.append(f\"  0x{mem_addr:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n\noutput_path = 'palette_search_results.txt'\nwith open(output_path, 'w') as out:\n    out.write('\\n'.join(lines))\n    \nprint(f\"Results written to {output_path}\")\n",

}

CMP instructions comparing to 7:\")\nfor i in range(CODE_START, min(CODE_START + 0x30000, len(data)-4)):\n    # 83 F8 07 = CMP EAX, 7\n    # 83 FB 07 = CMP EBX, 7  \n    # 83 F9 07 = CMP ECX, 7\n    # 83 FA 07 = CMP EDX, 7\n    if data[i] == 0x83 and data[i+1] in [0xF8, 0xF9, 0xFA, 0xFB] and data[i+2] == 0x07:\n        mem_addr = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        context = data[max(0,i-5):min(len(data),i+15)]\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n        lines.append(f\"  0x{mem_addr:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n    \n    # 3D 07 00 00 00 = CMP EAX, 7 (32-bit immediate)\n    if data[i] == 0x3D and data[i+1] == 0x07 and data[i+2:i+5] == b'\\x00\\x00\\x00':\n        mem_addr = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        context = data[max(0,i-5):min(len(data),i+15)]\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n        lines.append(f\"  0x{mem_addr:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n\n# Search for hotspot 353 (0x161) comparisons\nlines.append(\"\\n2. Comparisons with 353 (0x161) - hotspot ID:\")\nfor i in range(CODE_START, min(CODE_START + 0x30000, len(data)-4)):\n    # 66 3D 61 01 = CMP AX, 0x161\n    if data[i:i+4] == b'\\x66\\x3d\\x61\\x01':\n        mem_addr = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        context = data[max(0,i-5):min(len(data),i+15)]\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n        lines.append(f\"  0x{mem_addr:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n    \n    # 81 F8 61 01 00 00 = CMP EAX, 0x161\n    if data[i:i+3] == b'\\x81\\xf8\\x61' and data[i+3:i+6] == b'\\x01\\x00\\x00':\n        mem_addr = CODE_BASE + (i - CODE_START)\n        context = data[max(0,i-5):min(len(data),i+15)]\n        hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n        lines.append(f\"  0x{mem_addr:05X}: {hex_str}\")\n\n# Search for calls to set_vga_palette (0x244E8) within handler range\nlines.append(\"\\n3.     "original": "python3 &lt;&lt; 'PYEOF'\nimport struct\n\n# Read JUEGO.EXE\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\n# File offset for 0x47e58 in .object2 segment\n# Formula: file = 0x43200 + (mem - 0x40000)\n# 0x47e58 -&gt; 0x43200 + 0x7e58 = 0x4B058\nfile_offset = 0x4B058\n\nprint(f\"Reading action table from file offset 0x{file_offset:X}\")\nprint(f\"Memory address: 0x47E58\")\nprint()\n\nentries = []\noffset = file_offset\n\nwhile True:\n    action_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[offset:offset+2])[0]\n    func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', data[offset+2:offset+6])[0]\n    \n    if action_id == 0xFFFF:\n        print(f\"End marker found at offset 0x{offset:X}\")\n        break\n    \n    entries.append((action_id, func_ptr))\n    offset += 6\n\nprint(f\"\\nFound {len(entries)} action entries:\\n\")\n\n# Write to file\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/f8_action_table.txt', 'w') as out:\n    out.write(\"F8 Action Table (0xF8 Control Code Actions)\\n\")\n    out.write(\"=\" * 60 + \"\\n\")\n    out.write(f\"Memory Address: 0x47E58\\n\")\n    out.write(f\"File Offset: 0x{file_offset:X}\\n\")\n    out.write(f\"Total Entries: {len(entries)}\\n\")\n    out.write(\"=\" * 60 + \"\\n\\n\")\n    \n    out.write(\"Action ID | Function Ptr | Notes\\n\")\n    out.write(\"-\" * 60 + \"\\n\")\n    \n    for action_id, func_ptr in entries:\n        # Check if function pointer is in code segment\n        notes = \"\"\n        if 0x10000 &lt;= func_ptr &lt; 0x40000:\n            notes = \"Code segment\"\n        elif 0x40000 &lt;= func_ptr &lt; 0x50000:\n            notes = \"Data segment\"\n        \n        line = f\"0x{action_id:04X} ({action_id:5d}) | 0x{func_ptr:08X} | {notes}\"\n        print(line)\n        out.write(line + \"\\n\")\n\nprint(f\"\\nResults written to f8_action_table.txt\")\nPYEOF",

&lt;action_id_high&gt;\\n\\n\")\n        \n        out.write(\"Action ID | Ghidra Addr  | File Offset | First bytes at function\\n\")\n        out.write(\"-\" * 80 + \"\\n\")\n        \n        # Group by function pointer to identify shared handlers\n        func_to_actions = {}\n        for action_id, func_ptr, entry_offset in entries:\n            if func_ptr not in func_to_actions:\n                func_to_actions[func_ptr] = []\n            func_to_actions[func_ptr].append(action_id)\n        \n        for action_id, func_ptr, entry_offset in entries:\n            # Calculate file offset for code segment\n            if 0x10000 &lt;= func_ptr &lt; 6:\n                output_lines.append('ERROR: Unexpected end of file')\n                break\n            \n            room_number = struct.unpack('&lt;h', entry_data[0:2])[0]\n            func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', entry_data[2:6])[0]\n            \n            file_pos = TABLE_FILE_OFFSET + idx * 6\n            \n            if room_number == -1:\n                output_lines.append('[{:3d}] File 0x{:05X}: room = -1 (END OF TABLE)'.format(idx, file_pos))\n                break\n            \n            entry_line = '[{:3d}] File 0x{:05X}: room = {:3d}, func_ptr = 0x{:05X}'.format(\n                idx, file_pos, room_number, func_ptr)\n            entries.append((room_number, func_ptr))\n            \n            if room_number == 7:\n                room7_entry = (room_number, func_ptr)\n                entry_line += '  &lt;-- ROOM 7'\n            \n            if 0x22000 &lt;= func_ptr &lt;= 0x22FFF:\n                pointers_22xxx.append((room_number, func_ptr))\n                entry_line += '  &lt;-- IN 0x22xxx RANGE!'\n            \n            output_lines.append(entry_line)\n            idx += 1\n            \n            if idx &gt; 100:\n                output_lines.append('WARNING: Hit safety limit of 100 entries')\n                break\n        \n        output_lines.append('')\n        output_lines.append('=' * 60)\n        output_lines.append('SUMMARY')\n        output_lines.append('=' * 60)\n        output_lines.append('Total entries: {}'.format(len(entries)))\n        output_lines.append('')\n        \n        output_lines.append('ROOM 7 ENTRY:')\n        if room7_entry:\n            output_lines.append('  Room 7 -&gt; function at 0x{:05X}'.format(room7_entry[1]))\n        else:\n            output_lines.append('  NOT FOUND in table')\n        output_lines.append('')\n        \n        output_lines.append('POINTERS IN 0x22xxx RANGE:')\n        if pointers_22xxx:\n            for room, ptr in pointers_22xxx:\n                output_lines.append('  Room {} -&gt; 0x{:05X}'.format(room, ptr))\n        else:\n            output_lines.append('  None found')\n        output_lines.append('')\n        \n        output_lines.append('ALL FUNCTION POINTERS (sorted by address):')\n        sorted_by_ptr = sorted(entries, key=lambda x: x[1])\n        for room, ptr in sorted_by_ptr:\n            output_lines.append('  0x{:05X} -&gt; room {}'.format(ptr, room))\n        \n        output_text = '\\n'.join(output_lines)\n        \n        with open('room_dispatch_table.txt', 'w') as out:\n            out.write(output_text)\n        \n        print(output_text)\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDump raw bytes at the room dispatch table location for verification\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nTABLE_FILE_OFFSET = 0x4B830\n\nwith open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(TABLE_FILE_OFFSET)\n    \n    print(\"Raw bytes at file offset 0x{:X}:\".format(TABLE_FILE_OFFSET))\n    print(\"-\" * 60)\n    \n    for i in range(10):\n        entry = f.read(6)\n        hex_str = ' '.join('{:02X}'.format(b) for b in entry)\n        \n        room = struct.unpack('&lt;h', entry[0:2])[0]\n        ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;I', entry[2:6])[0]\n        \n        print(\"Entry {:2d}: {} | room={:5d}, ptr=0x{:08X}\".format(i, hex_str, room, ptr))\n        \n        if room == -1:\n            break\n\nprint()\nprint(\"Checking if these might be segment:offset pairs instead...\")\nprint(\"-\" * 60)\n\nf.seek(TABLE_FILE_OFFSET)\nfor i in range(10):\n    entry = f.read(6)\n    room = struct.unpack('&lt;h', entry[0:2])[0]\n    offset = struct.unpack('&lt;H', entry[2:4])[0]\n    segment = struct.unpack('&lt;H', entry[4:6])[0]\n    \n    linear = (segment &lt;&lt; 4) + offset\n    \n    print(\"Entry {:2d}: room={:5d}, offset=0x{:04X}, seg=0x{:04X}, linear=0x{:05X}\".format(\n        i, room, offset, segment, linear))\n    \n    if room == -1:\n        break\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

len(data):\n            addr16 = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[pos+1:pos+3])[0]\n            instr = \"mov ax, [0x{:04X}]\".format(addr16)\n            size = 3\n        elif op == 0xA3 and pos+2 &lt; len(data):\n            addr16 = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[pos+1:pos+3])[0]\n            instr = \"mov [0x{:04X}], ax\".format(addr16)\n            size = 3\n        elif op == 0x8B and pos+1 &lt; len(data):\n            modrm = data[pos+1]\n            instr = \"mov r16, rm16 (modrm={:02X})\".format(modrm)\n            size = 2\n            if (modrm &amp; 0xC7) == 0x06 and pos+3 &lt; len(data):\n                # [disp16] addressing\n                disp = struct.unpack(\"&lt;H\", data[pos+2:pos+4])[0]\n                reg = (modrm &gt;&gt; 3) &amp; 7\n                regs = [\"ax\", \"cx\", \"dx\", \"bx\", \"sp\", \"bp\", \"si\", \"di\"]\n                instr = \"mov {}, [0x{:04X}]\".format(regs[reg], disp)\n                size = 4\n        elif op == 0x89 and pos+1 &lt; len(data):\n            instr = \"out 0x{:02X}, al\".format(data[pos+1])\n            size = 2\n        elif op == 0xCD and pos+1 &lt; len(data):\n            instr = \"int 0x{:02X}\".format(data[pos+1])\n            size = 2\n        elif op == 0xFC:\n            instr = \"cld\"\n        elif op == 0xFD:\n            instr = \"std\"\n        elif op == 0xFA:\n            instr = \"cli\"\n        elif op == 0xFB:\n            instr = \"sti\"\n        elif op == 0x40:\n            instr = \"inc ax\"\n        elif op == 0x41:\n            instr = \"inc cx\"\n        elif op == 0x42:\n            instr = \"inc dx\"\n        elif op == 0x43:\n            instr = \"inc bx\"\n        elif op == 0x46:\n            instr = \"inc si\"\n        elif op == 0x47:\n            instr = \"inc di\"\n        elif op == 0x48:\n            instr = \"dec ax\"\n        elif op == 0x49:\n            instr = \"dec cx\"\n        elif op == 0x4A:\n            instr = \"dec dx\"\n        elif op == 0x4E:\n            instr = \"dec si\"\n        elif op == 0x4F:\n            instr = \"dec di\"\n        elif op == 0xFE and pos+1 &lt;   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Extract and analyze the amulet+statue handler from JUEGO.EXE\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\n# File offset formula: file = 0x14200 + (mem - 0x10000)\n# Table at 0x48118, entry 6 = offset 0x30, so 0x48148 -&gt; file offset = 0x14200 + (0x48148 - 0x10000) = 0x55D48\n\ndef read_item_combination_table():\n    \"\"\"Read the item combination table from JUEGO.EXE\"\"\"\n    with open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n        # Table starts at memory 0x48118, file offset = 0x14200 + (0x48118 - 0x10000) = 0x55318\n        table_file_offset = 0x14200 + (0x48118 - 0x10000)\n        f.seek(table_file_offset)\n        \n        print(\"ITEM COMBINATION TABLE (0x48118)\")\n        print(\"=\" * 70)\n        print(f\"{'Entry':&lt;6} {'Item1':&lt;8} {'Item2':&lt;8} {'FuncPtr':&lt;12} Notes\")\n        print(\"-\" * 70)\n        \n        for i in range(20):  # Read first 20 entries\n            entry = f.read(8)\n            if len(entry) &lt; 8:\n                break\n            \n            item1, item2, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', entry)\n            \n            if item1 == 0xFFFF:\n                print(f\"{i:&lt;6} END OF TABLE\")\n                break\n            \n            notes = \"\"\n            if item1 == 353 and item2 == 7:\n                notes = \" &lt;-- AMULET + STATUE\"\n            elif item1 == 7:\n                notes = \" (amulet as item1)\"\n            elif item2 == 7:\n                notes = \" (amulet as item2)\"\n                \n            print(f\"{i:&lt;6} {item1:&lt;8} {item2:&lt;8} 0x{func_ptr:08X} {notes}\")\n        \n        return table_file_offset\n\ndef read_handler_code(func_ptr):\n    \"\"\"Read and display the handler code at the given memory address\"\"\"\n    # Convert memory address to file offset\n    file_offset = 0x14200 + (func_ptr - 0x10000)\n    \n    print(f\"\\nHANDLER CODE at 0x{func_ptr:05X} (file offset 0x{file_offset:05X})\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    with open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n        f.seek(file_offset)\n        data = f.read(256)\n    \n    print(\"\\nRaw hex dump:\")\n    print(\"-\" * 60)\n    for i in range(0, min(128, len(data)), 16):\n        hex_part = \" \".join(f\"{b:02X}\" for b in data[i:i+16])\n        ascii_part = \"\".join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else \".\" for b in data[i:i+16])\n        print(f\"{func_ptr+i:05X}: {hex_part:&lt;48} {ascii_part}\")\n    \n    return data\n\ndef analyze_handler_for_palette_operations(data, func_ptr):\n    \"\"\"Search for VGA palette operations in the handler code\"\"\"\n    print(\"\\n\\nPALETTE OPERATION ANALYSIS\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    \n    # Look for:\n    # - VGA ports: 0x3C8, 0x3C9\n    # - out dx, al (0xEE)\n    # - in al, dx (0xEC)\n    # - Loop value 13 (0x0D)\n    \n    findings = []\n    \n    for i in range(len(data)):\n        # Check for out dx, al\n        if data[i] == 0xEE:\n            findings.append(f\"  0x{func_ptr+i:05X}: OUT DX, AL - write to port in DX\")\n        \n        # Check for in al, dx\n        if data[i] == 0xEC:\n            findings.append(f\"  0x{func_ptr+i:05X}: IN AL, DX - read from port in DX\")\n        \n        # Check for mov dx, immediate (BA xx xx - 16-bit immediate)\n        if data[i] == 0xBA and i + 2 &lt; len(data):\n            imm = struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[i+1:i+3])[0]\n            if imm in [0x3C8, 0x3C9]:\n                findings.append(f\"  0x{func_ptr+i:05X}: MOV DX, 0x{imm:04X} - VGA palette port!\")\n            elif imm &lt; 0x1000:\n                findings.append(f\"  0x{func_ptr+i:05X}: MOV DX, 0x{imm:04X}\")\n        \n        # Check for CALL near (E8 xx xx)\n        if data[i] == 0xE8 and i + 2 &lt; len(data):\n            rel = struct.unpack('&lt;h', data[i+1:i+3])[0]\n            target = (func_ptr + i + 3 + rel) &amp; 0xFFFFFFFF\n            findings.append(f\"  0x{func_ptr+i:05X}: CALL 0x{target:05X}\")\n        \n        # Check for loop counter value 13\n        if data[i] == 0x0D:\n            context = data[max(0,i-2):i+3]\n            findings.append(f\"  0x{func_ptr+i:05X}: Found 0x0D (13) - context: {context.hex()}\")\n    \n    if findings:\n        print(\"Potential palette-related operations found:\")\n        for f in findings:\n            print(f)\n    else:\n        print(\"No obvious palette operations found in first 128 bytes\")\n\ndef main():\n    print(\"AMULET + STATUE HANDLER ANALYSIS\")\n    print(\"=\" * 70)\n    print(\"Looking for entry 6: item1=353 (statue), item2=7 (amulet)\")\n    print()\n    \n    # Read the table and find entry 6\n    read_item_combination_table()\n    \n    # Entry 6 is at 0x48118 + 6*8 = 0x48148\n    with open(\"files/JUEGO.EXE\", \"rb\") as f:\n        entry_offset = 0x14200 + (0x48148 - 0x10000)\n        f.seek(entry_offset)\n        entry = f.read(8)\n        item1, item2, func_ptr = struct.unpack('&lt;HHI', entry)\n        print(f\"\\nEntry 6 details:\")\n        print(f\"  File offset: 0x{entry_offset:05X}\")\n        print(f\"  item1 = {item1} (0x{item1:04X})\")\n        print(f\"  item2 = {item2} (0x{item2:04X})\")\n        print(f\"  function_ptr = 0x{func_ptr:08X}\")\n    \n    # Now read the handler code at that function pointer\n    if func_ptr &lt; 0x10000 or func_ptr &gt; 0x60000:\n        print(f\"\\nWarning: Function pointer 0x{func_ptr:08X} seems invalid!\")\n        # Try interpreting the raw bytes differently\n        print(\"Raw entry bytes:\", entry.hex())\n    else:\n        data = read_handler_code(func_ptr)\n        analyze_handler_for_palette_operations(data, func_ptr)\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
